plan.mechanism: For every original parent whose complete direct-consumer set contains only leaves, compute their AND Q. Submit original P, then promote the retained P value to Q and serve all its children contiguously. Q has no new SRAM address or global parent identity.
candidate_rules: Every direct consumer is a leaf
No subgroup selection, pairwise search, added cache or new parent assignment
plan.baseline: Same original forest, same complete leaf-star service order, same retained parent and child working register. Ordinary forwarding and retained-parent SRAM reductions credited to both sides.
plan.sample_status: Same already-inspected 192-tile cohort; exploratory, not a new blind test
counts: All parent child-list scans, leaf tests and mask-AND operations
Common parent-retention service opportunity separated from promotion
Original destinations and exact rational lane values
plan.expected_stop: If complete-leaf-star common residual is absent or small, stop this variant rather than introduce subgroup search after seeing data.

limits: Parent-retention and contiguous child service are credited to both sides, not promotion novelty.
Child-directory construction, scans, leaf tests, mask AND and service scheduling are counted logically, not timed.
No new global parent identity or SRAM address is allocated, but each child seed copy and original destination commit remains.
Exact rational diagnostic is not frozen FP32, Acc24 or old 96x12 mapped-width proof.
Same inspected cohort. No subgroup selection after observing these results.
